name: vscode-zellij-panel
description: Run Zellij in a Pseudoterminal-backed panel and visualize Claude Code file edits via hooks + file watching.

commands.title: Zellij Panel: Install Claude Code Hook

vscode-zellij-panel.sessionMode.description: new = create a fresh Zellij session; attach = attach to an existing session name.

vscode-zellij-panel.attachName.description: Zellij session name to attach when sessionMode is 'attach'.

vscode-zellij-panel.listenClaude.description: When true, listen for Claude Code edits via local hook server + file watching and show diffs. When false, the panel only runs Zellij without edit capture.

vscode-zellij-panel.hookPort.description: Port for the local Claude Code hook receiver.
